page.notes: The Greek words in the entries "Αὐτοφιλαυτία" and "Ἀστοργία" are my best reading of a small, blurred print and are marked [?]. The small degree-like marks (°) printed before the two Greek entries are not transcribed. The entry "Aulici maris venti" breaks at "Prin-" and continues on the following page. The "Pernicies" line break ("Perni-" / "cies") is hard to read at this resolution. "Concilient" is followed by a mark that may be a dash or a stop; I have given a full stop.
